paragraphs: We are a vertically integrated real estate finance company founded in 2004. We originate, securitize, and manage a nationwide portfolio of loans secured by real estate to earn attractive risk adjusted spreads for our shareholders. We primarily originate investor loans secured by 1-4 unit residential rental properties, as well as loans for multi-family, mixed use and commercial properties. We originate loans nationwide across our extensive network of independent mortgage brokers and direct borrower relationships, which we have built and refined over the 21 years since our inception. Our objective is to be the preferred and one of the most recognized brands in our core market.

We operate in a large and highly fragmented market with substantial demand for financing and limited supply of institutional financing alternatives. We have developed the highly-specialized skill set required to effectively compete in this market, which we believe has afforded us a durable business model capable of generating attractive risk-adjusted returns for our stockholders throughout various business cycles. We offer competitive pricing to our borrowers by pursuing low-cost financing strategies and by driving front-end process efficiencies through customized technology designed to control the cost of originating a loan. Furthermore, by originating loans through our efficient and scalable network of approved mortgage brokers, we are able to maintain a wide geographical presence and nimble operating infrastructure capable of reacting quickly to changing market environments.

We believe there is a substantial and durable market opportunity for investor real estate loans across 1-4 unit residential rental and small commercial properties, and that our institutionalized approach to serving these fragmented market segments underpins our long-term business strategy. Our growth to date has validated the need for scaled lenders with dedication to individual investors who own ten or fewer properties, a base which we believe represents the vast majority of activity across our core market. According to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the U.S. home rentership rate (the inverse of the home ownership rate) has averaged approximately 34.3%. According to a press release by Zillow on Sep 8, 2025, the U.S. housing market is worth a record $55.1 trillion. Ownership of residential properties for rent has historically been concentrated among smaller investors. According to data published by CNBC on Oct 7, 2025, more than 90% of small investors own 10 properties or less, while the largest investors, those with 1,000 or more properties, comprise 2% of all investor-owned homes.

Our primary growth strategy is predicated on organically continuing to serve and build loyalty within our network of mortgage brokers, while also expanding our network with new mortgage brokers through targeted marketing and improved brand awareness. We believe our reputation and 21-year history within our core market position us well to capture future growth opportunities. We continue to opportunistically pursue inorganic growth strategies such as acquiring portfolios of loans that meet our investment criteria and acquisitions of businesses that align with our strategic vision.
We make loans for business purposes only, which we believe limits our exposure to the regulatory constraints of consumer lending.

On January 16, 2020, we converted from a limited liability company to a corporation incorporated under the law of the State of Delaware by filing a certificate of conversion with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware and changed our name from Velocity Financial, LLC to Velocity Financial, Inc. On January 22, 2020, we completed the initial public offering ("IPO") of our common stock, par value $0.01 per share (our "common stock"). Shares of our common stock trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "VEL." The Company's stock also trades on the NYSE Texas, Inc. under the same symbol "VEL" starting August 2025.

On December 28, 2021, the Company acquired an 80% ownership interest in Century Health & Housing Capital, LLC ("Century"). Century is a licensed Government National Mortgage Association ("Ginnie Mae" or "GNMA") issuer/servicer that provides government-insured Federal Housing Administration ("FHA") mortgage financing for multifamily housing, senior housing and long-term care/assisted living facilities. Century originates loans through its borrower-direct origination channel and services the loans through its in-house servicing platform, which enables the formation of long-term relationships with its clients and drives strong portfolio retention. Century earns origination fees from originating loans, and servicing fees from mortgage servicing rights on its servicing portfolio. Century is a consolidated subsidiary of the Company as of completion of the acquisition. In addition, as a
servicer of Ginnie Mae loans, Century is required to maintain a minimum net worth, and is in compliance with this requirement as of December 31, 2025.

Our operational and financial performance will depend on certain market developments, including the impact of tariffs, the actions of the Federal Reserve, the ongoing Russia/Ukraine war, conflicts in the Middle East, the recent U.S. government shutdown, heightened stress in the real estate and corporate debt markets, and macroeconomic conditions and market fundamentals, which can all affect each of these factors and potentially impact our business performance.
We believe that the following competitive advantages enhance our ability to execute our business strategy and position us well for future growth:

We believe our reputation and deep history within the real estate lending community position us as a preferred lender for mortgage brokers. We have been originating and acquiring loans in our core market since our inception in 2004, making us a recognizable brand with a proven ability to execute. Additionally, we have successfully executed 46 securitizations of our investor real estate loans, issuing $10.6 billion in principal amount of securities between 2011 and the year ended December 31, 2025. We have a keen understanding of this securitization market, including complicated structural issues, investor expectations and rating agency requirements. We executed our thirty-eighth through forty-sixth securitizations in 2025. We believe this demonstrates that we have a strong reputation with investors in the securitization market, which enables us to maintain efficient access to debt capital that ultimately improves our ability to offer competitive pricing to our borrowers.

We have invested in and customized automated systems to support our use of data analytics which drives our lending process. We believe the investor real estate lending market requires a highly-specialized skill set and infrastructure. To effectively compete and execute on a sustainable long-term business strategy, lenders must control the cost to originate and manage loans without sacrificing credit quality. We believe our investment in technology and use of data analytics helps us achieve these critical objectives and positions our business for sustainable, long-term growth.

We apply the same asset-driven underwriting process to all the loans in our portfolio, regardless of whether we originate or acquire these loans. Our credit and underwriting philosophy encompasses individual borrower and property due diligence, taking into consideration several factors. Our access to 21 years of proprietary data allows us to perform analytics that inform our lending decisions efficiently and effectively, which we believe is a strong competitive advantage.

We believe our in-place portfolio provides a significant and stable income stream for us to invest in future earnings growth. Our loans are structured to provide interest rate protection. The majority of our loans are fixed-rate loans and a smaller portion of our loans are floating after an initial fixed-rate period, subject to a floor equal to the starting fixed rate. The loans are mainly financed with long-term fixed-rate debt, resulting in a spread that could increase over time, but not decrease. As a result, our in-place portfolio spread generally benefits from rising interest rates. We generated $210.4 million in portfolio related net interest income for the year ended December 31, 2025, representing a 3.61% net interest margin during the year.

headings: Risks Related to Our Financial Performance, Financing Our Business, Liquidity and Net Worth, and the Economy
Risks Relating to Ownership of Our Common Stock
Difficult conditions in the real estate markets, the financial markets and the economy generally may adversely impact our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Adverse global market, economic and political conditions, including government shutdowns, armed conflicts or terrorist acts, pandemics and other catastrophic events could have a material adverse effect on us.

Loans to small businesses involve a high degree of business and financial risk, which can result in substantial losses that would adversely affect our business, results of operation and financial condition.
We are dependent on certain of our key personnel for our future success, and their continued service to us is not guaranteed.
Our growth strategy relies upon our ability to hire and retain qualified account executives, and if we are unable to do so, our growth could be limited.
Inaccurate or incomplete information received from potential borrowers, guarantors and sellers involved in the sale of pools of loans could have a negative impact on our results of operation.
Deficiencies in appraisal quality in the mortgage loan origination process may result in increased principal loss severity.
We use leverage in executing our business strategy, which may adversely affect us when economic conditions are unfavorable.
Our underwriting guidelines in the mortgage loan origination process may result in increased delinquencies and defaults.
We may change our strategy or underwriting guidelines without notice or stockholder consent, which may result in changes to our risk profile, results of operations and financial condition.
Our inability to manage future growth effectively could have an adverse impact on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Operational risks, including the risk of cyberattacks and other security incidents, could disrupt our business and materially and adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Any disruption in the availability or functionality of our technology infrastructure and systems could have a material adverse effect on our business.

Acquisitions, strategic investments, entries into new businesses, and divestitures could disrupt our business, divert our management's attention, result in additional dilution to our stockholders, and harm our business.
Risks Related to Our Loan Portfolio
A significant portion of our loan portfolio is in the form of investor real estate loans which are subject to increased risks.
Loans on properties in transition will involve a greater risk of loss than traditional investment-grade mortgage loans with fully insured borrowers.
Any costs or delays involved in the completion of a foreclosure or liquidation of the underlying property may further reduce proceeds from the property and may increase the loss.
Insurance on collateral underlying mortgage loans and real estate securities may not cover all losses.
We may be subject to lender liability claims, and if we are held liable under such claims, we could be subject to losses.
We may be exposed to environmental liabilities with respect to properties to which we take title, which may in turn decrease the value of the underlying properties.

We may be required to repurchase or substitute mortgage loans or indemnify investors if we breach representations and warranties, which could harm our business, cash flow, results of operations and financial condition.

An investment in our common stock involves significant risk. We describe below material risks that management believes affect or could affect our performance. Understanding these risks is important to understanding any statement in this Annual Report and to evaluating an investment in our common stock. You should carefully read and consider the risks and uncertainties described below together with all the other information included or incorporated by reference in this Annual Report before you make any decision regarding an investment in our common stock. If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, liquidity and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected. If this were to happen, the value of our common stock could significantly decline, and you could lose some or all of your investment. While the following discussion provides a description of material risks that could cause our results to vary materially from those expressed in public statements or documents, other factors besides those discussed within this Annual Report or elsewhere in other of our reports filed with or furnished to the SEC could also affect our business, financial condition, liquidity and results of operations.

As a non-bank mortgage company, we are exposed in the normal course of business to multiple risks shared by other participants in our industry. In addition, some of the risks we face are unique to Velocity or such risks could have a different or greater impact on Velocity than on other companies. These risks could adversely impact our business, regulatory or agency approval, financial condition, liquidity, results of operations, ability to grow, and reputation, and are summarized below. This summary is intended to supplement, and should not be considered a substitute for, the complete Risk Factors that follow.
• Conditions in the real estate markets, the financial markets and the economy generally
• Fiscal policies or inaction at the U.S. federal government level, which have led to and may in the future lead to federal government shutdowns or negative impacts on the U.S. economy

• Disruptions in the capital markets, including market fluctuations and economic instability as a result of tariffs, trade restrictions, armed conflict and other geopolitical disruptions or conditions

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read together with the consolidated financial statements and related notes and the other financial information included elsewhere in this Annual Report. This discussion contains forward-looking statements, as described above under the heading "Forward-Looking Statements" that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those discussed below and elsewhere in this Annual Report.

We are a vertically integrated real estate finance company founded in 2004. We primarily originate and manage investor loans secured by 1-4 unit residential rental and commercial properties, which we collectively refer to as investor real estate loans.

Our primary source of revenue is interest income earned on our loan portfolio. Our typical loan is secured by a first lien on the underlying property with a personal guarantee and, based on all loans in our portfolio as of December 31, 2025, has an average balance of approximately $390 thousand. As of December 31, 2025, our loan portfolio totaled $6.5 billion of UPB on properties in 48 states and the District of Columbia. The total portfolio had a weighted average loan-to-value ratio, or LTV at origination, of 65.2%, and was concentrated in 1-4 unit residential rental loans, which we refer to as investor 1-4 loans, representing 48.1% of UPB. For the year ended December 31, 2025, the yield on our total portfolio was 9.45%.

We fund our portfolio primarily through a combination of committed and uncommitted secured warehouse facilities, securitized debt, unsecured debt, corporate debt and equity. The securitized debt market is our primary source of long-term, non-recourse financing. We have successfully executed 46 securitized debt offerings, issuing $10.6 billion in principal amount of securities from May 2011 through December 2025.

Besides net income, another core profitably measurement is our portfolio related net interest margin, which measures the difference between interest income earned on loans and interest expense paid on portfolio-related debt, relative to the amount of loans outstanding over the period. Our portfolio-related debt consists of warehouse facilities and securitized debt and excludes corporate debt. For the year ended December 31, 2025, our portfolio related net interest margin was 3.61%. We generate profits to the extent that our portfolio related net interest income exceeds our interest expense on corporate debt, provision for credit losses and operating expenses. For the year ended December 31, 2025, including net income attributable to noncontrolling interest, we generated pre-tax and net income of $146.2 million and $105.0 million, respectively, and earned a pre-tax return on average equity and return on average equity of 24.4% and 17.5%, respectively.

Due to a number of factors, our historical financial results may not be comparable, either from period to period, or to our financial results in future periods. We have summarized the key factors affecting the comparability of our financial results below.
In January 2026, the Company completed the issuance and sale of $500.0 million aggregate principal amount of 9.375% Senior Notes ("the 2026 Term Notes") which will mature on February 15, 2031.
In February 2024, the Company issued $75.0 million principal amount of five-year Senior Secured Notes. The Notes bear interest at 9.875% and mature on February 15, 2029.

From September 2023, the Company utilized forward starting interest rate swaps or interest rate payer and receiver swaptions designated as cash flow hedges to manage the exposure to interest rate volatility associated with future issuances of fixed-rate debt. The gains or losses on these interest rate derivative instruments that are designated and qualify as cash flow hedges are reported as a component of accumulated other comprehensive income.

We made an election to apply FVO accounting to all our originated mortgage loans on a go-forward basis beginning October 1, 2022. The fair value option loans are presented as a separate line item in the Consolidated Balance Sheets. We do not record an allowance for credit losses on fair value option loans.

The FVO accounting for our securitized debt is on a case-by-case basis effective January 1, 2023. The fair value option securitized debt is presented as a separate line item in the Consolidated Balance Sheets.

Our REMIC transactions can create significant U.S. GAAP versus tax differences. The U.S. GAAP treatment considers each REMIC as a variable interest entity that is required to be consolidated in our financial statements, accounting for the securitization as a secured borrowing. Under IRS rules, the REMICs require sale treatment, and we are required to either recognize taxable income or loss to the extent the fair market value of the REMICs is greater than or less than our cost basis, the payment of which creates either a deferred tax asset or deferred tax liability.

We will continue to recognize deferred tax assets and liabilities for future tax consequences attributable to differences between the financial statement carrying amounts of our existing assets and liabilities and their respective tax bases. Deferred tax assets and liabilities are measured using the tax rates expected to apply to taxable income in the years in which those temporary differences are expected to be recovered or settled. The effect on deferred tax assets and liabilities of a change in tax rates is recognized in the statements of operations in the period that included the enactment date, as applicable.

In March 2022, we entered into a five-year $215.0 million syndicated corporate debt agreement ("the 2022 Term Loan"). The 2022 Term Loan was paid off on January 30, 2026 with proceeds from the issuance and sale of $500 million Senior Notes. In February 2024, we entered into a five-year $75.0 million syndicated corporate debt agreement ("the 2024 Term Loan"). We incurred $24.6 million, $23.8 million and $16.6 million of interest expense related to our corporate debt for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家垂直整合的不動產金融公司，於2004年成立。本公司發放、證券化並管理全國範圍內以不動產為擔保的貸款組合，以為股東賺取有吸引力的風險調整後利差。本公司主要發放投資人貸款，以1-4戶住宅租賃不動產為擔保，以及多戶住宅、混合用途及商業不動產貸款。本公司透過廣泛的獨立房貸經紀網路及直接借款人關係發放貸款，這些網路與關係自本公司成立以來的21年間持續建立與完善。本公司目標為成為核心市場中受歡迎且最知名的品牌之一。

本公司營運於一個規模龐大且高度分散的市場，此市場對融資需求龐大，但機構融資選擇有限。本公司已發展出高度專業的技能，以有效競爭此市場，我們相信這使本公司擁有可持續的商業模式，能在不同經濟週期中為股東產生有吸引力的風險調整後回報。本公司透過追求低成本融資策略及透過客製化資訊科技提升前端作業效率，為借款人提供具競爭力的價格。此外，透過高效能且可擴展的批准房貸經紀網路發放貸款，本公司得以維持廣泛的地理佈局與靈活的運作基礎，能迅速應對市場環境的變化。

本公司相信，在1-4戶住宅租賃及小型商業不動產領域，投資人不動產貸款存在龐大且可持續的市場機會，而本公司對這些分散市場區塊的制度化服務方式，是本公司長期商業策略的基礎。截至目前為止的成長已驗證，需要具規模的貸款人專注於擁有十戶或以下不動產的投資人，而我們相信這一羣體代表本公司核心市場的絕大多數交易活動。根據美國人口普查局的資料，美國的租賃住宅率（即住宅擁有率的反轉）平均約為34.3%。根據Zillow於2025年9月8日發佈的聲明，美國住宅市場價值創下歷史新高，達55.1兆美元。住宅租賃不動產的擁有者歷來主要集中在較小的投資人手中。根據CNBC於2025年10月7日發佈的資料，超過90%的小型投資人擁有10戶或以下的不動產，而擁有1,000戶或以上不動產的大型投資人，則僅佔所有投資人擁有住宅的2%。
本公司主要成長策略係基於持續透過內部方式服務並建立忠誠度於房貸經紀網路，同時透過針對性行銷與提升品牌知名度擴展新的房貸經紀網路。我們相信，我們的聲譽與在核心市場21年的歷史經驗，使我們能有效把握未來的成長機會。我們持續尋求非內部成長策略，例如取得符合我們投資標準的貸款組合，以及取得與我們戰略願景相符的企業。
本公司僅發放用於商業用途的貸款，我們相信這有助於降低我們受到消費者貸款監管限制的風險。

於2020年1月16日，本公司將公司形式從有限責任公司轉為依照特拉華州法律設立的股份有限公司，並向特拉華州州務卿提交轉換憑證，同時將公司名稱從Velocity Financial, LLC改為Velocity Financial, Inc。於2020年1月22日，本公司完成普通股（"common stock"）的首次公開發行（"IPO"），每股票面價值為0.01美元（"common stock"）。本公司普通股於紐約證券交易所（NYSE）交易，代碼為"VEL"。本公司股票亦於紐約證券交易所（Texas）交易，代碼為"VEL"，自2025年8月起。

於2021年12月28日，本公司取得Century Health & Housing Capital, LLC（"Century"）80%的股權。Century為一家經許可的政府國家住宅抵押貸款協會（"Ginnie Mae"或"GNMA"）發行者/服務商，提供政府擔保的美國住宅管理局（"FHA"）房貸融資，用於多戶住宅、長者住宅及長期照護/輔助生活設施。Century透過直接借款人發放貸款，並透過其內部服務平台服務貸款，這有助於與客戶建立長期關係，並推動貸款組合的高保留率。Century從發放貸款中賺取發放手續費，並從其服務貸款組合的房貸服務權中賺取服務手續費。Century自取得該股權後即為本公司合併財務報表的子公司。此外，作為Ginnie Mae貸款的服務商，Century必須維持最低淨 worth，截至2025年12月31日，Century已符合此要求。
作為Ginnie Mae貸款的服務商，Century必須維持最低淨 worth，截至2025年12月31日，Century已符合此要求。
本公司之營運及財務表現將取決於某些市場發展，包括關稅之影響、聯邦儲備系統之措施、俄羅斯與烏克蘭戰爭之持續、中東地區衝突、美國政府最近之停擺、不動產與企業債務市場之壓力升高，以及總體經濟條件與市場基本面，這些因素皆可能影響各項因素，並可能影響本公司之營運表現。
本公司認為，以下競爭優勢可增強本公司執行業務策略之能力，並使本公司在未來成長中處於優勢地位：

本公司認為，本公司在不動產貸款領域之聲譽與深厚歷史，使本公司成為房貸經紀之首選貸款人。本公司自2004年成立以來，一直在核心市場發放與取得貸款，使本公司成為一個知名品牌，具備已證實之執行能力。此外，本公司已成功執行46次投資者不動產貸款之證券化，於2011年至2025年12月31日止，發行本金金額計10.6 十億美元之證券。本公司對此證券化市場有深刻理解，包括複雜之結構問題、投資者期待與評級機構之要求。本公司於2025年執行第三十八至第四十六次證券化。本公司認為，這顯示本公司在證券化市場中擁有強大聲譽，使本公司能維持有效之債務資金來源，最終提高本公司對貸款人提供競爭性利率之能力。
本公司已投資並客製化自動化系統，以支援本公司使用資料分析，以驅動貸款流程。本公司認為，投資者不動產貸款市場需要高度專業之技能與基礎設施。為有效競爭並執行可持續之長期業務策略，貸款人必須控制貸款之發放與管理成本，而不影響信用品質。本公司認為，本公司對科技之投資與資料分析之使用，有助於達成這些關鍵目標，並使本公司業務處於可持續之長期成長地位。
本公司對所有貸款均採用相同之資產驅動式授信流程，無論貸款係本公司發放或取得。本公司之信用與授信哲學涵蓋貸款人與不動產之個別審查，考量多項因素。本公司對21年之專屬資料有存取能力，使本公司能執行資料分析，以有效且高效地支援貸款決策，本公司認為此為強大之競爭優勢。

本公司認為，本公司現有之貸款組合為本公司投資未來獲利成長提供重要且穩定之收入來源。本公司之貸款結構提供利率保護。本公司之貸款多為固定利率貸款，較少數之貸款為浮動利率，但於初始固定利率期間後，其利率受一地板利率之限制，該地板利率等同於初始固定利率。貸款主要由長期固定利率債務資金支應，導致利差可能隨時間增加，但不會減少。因此，本公司現有貸款組合之利差通常受益於利率上漲。本公司於2025年12月31日止之年度，產生210.4 百萬美元之貸款組合相關淨利息收入，代表該年度之淨利息邊際為3.61%。

paragraphs: 下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，應與合併財務報表及相關附註，以及其他財務資訊一併閱讀。此討論包含向前看的陳述，如上文「向前看陳述」標題所述，涉及風險與不確定性。我們的實際結果可能與這些向前看陳述中預期的結果有重大差異，原因包括下列所討論的各種因素，以及本年度報告其他地方所提及的內容。
我們是一家垂直整合的不動產金融公司，於2004年成立。我們主要發放並管理由1-4戶住宅租賃及商業不動產擔保的投資者貸款，我們 collectively 稱為投資者不動產貸款。

我們的主要收入來源為貸款組合所產生的利息收入。我們的典型貸款由擔保物的首優先權抵押及個人擔保所保障，根據我們貸款組閤中截至2025年12月31日的所有貸款，平均餘額約為390千美元。截至2025年12月31日，我們的貸款組合總計為6.5十億美元的UPB，涉及48個州及華盛頓特區的不動產。總體貸款組合的加權平均貸款價值比，或稱為貸款價值比（LTV），為65.2%，且主要集中在1-4戶住宅租賃貸款，我們稱為投資者1-4貸款，佔UPB的48.1%。截至2025年12月31日財年，我們總體貸款組合的收益率為9.45%。
我們主要透過committed及uncommitted的擔保倉庫設施、證券化債務、無擔保債務、公司債務及權益來資金融通貸款組合。證券化債務市場為我們長期非追索權融資的主要來源。我們已成功執行46次證券化債務發行，發行金額為10.6十億美元的證券，自2011年5月至2025年12月。

除了淨收入外，另一個核心獲利指標為與貸款組合相關的淨利息邊際，用以衡量貸款產生的利息收入與與貸款組合相關債務所支付的利息之間的差額，相對於貸款組合期間的貸款餘額。我們的貸款組合相關債務包括倉庫設施及證券化債務，並排除公司債務。截至2025年12月31日財年，我們的貸款組合相關淨利息邊際為3.61%。我們獲利的程度取決於貸款組合相關淨利息收入是否超過公司債務的利息支出、信貸減損提列及營運費用。截至2025年12月31日財年，包括非控制權益的淨收入，我們產生了146.2百萬美元的稅前淨收入及105.0百萬美元的淨收入，分別，並實現了24.4%及17.5%的稅前平均權益回報率及平均權益回報率。
由於多種因素，我們的歷史財務結果可能無法與過往期間或未來期間的財務結果進行比較。我們在下方總結影響我們財務結果可比性的關鍵因素。
2026年1月，本公司完成了發行及銷售總金額為500.0百萬美元的9.375%優先無擔保債券（"2026年定期債券"），該債券將於2031年2月15日到期。
2024年2月，本公司發行了總金額為75.0百萬美元的五年期優先擔保債券。這些債券利率為9.875%，並於2029年2月15日到期。
自2023年9月起，本公司利用遠期起始利率期貨合約或利率支付及接收選擇權，並指定為現金流避險工具，以管理未來發行固定利率債務所產生的利率波動風險。這些利率衍生工具的獲利或損失，若被指定且符合現金流避險條件，則列為累計其他綜合損益之零組件。
本公司自2022年10月1日起，對所有新發行的房貸貸款採用公平價值選項會計處理。公平價值選項貸款於合併資產負債表中以獨立項目列示。本公司對公平價值選項貸款不計提信用減損準備。
本公司對資產證券化債務的公平價值選項會計處理，自2023年1月1日起依個案而定。公平價值選項資產證券化債務於合併資產負債表中以獨立項目列示。
我們的REMIC交易可能產生美國會計準則（U.S. GAAP）與稅務處理的重大差異。根據美國會計準則，每個REMIC均被視為變動權益實體，並需於財務報表中合併會計，將證券化視為擔保借款。根據美國國稅局（IRS）規則，REMIC需視為銷售處理，本公司需認列稅收所得或損失，範圍為REMIC之公允市價大於或小於本公司成本基礎之差額，此差額之支付將產生遞延稅資產或遞延稅負債。
本公司將持續認列遞延稅資產及負債，以反映未來稅務後果，該後果源自本公司現有資產及負債之財務報表攜帶金額與其稅務基礎之間的差異。遞延稅資產及負債以預期適用於課稅所得之稅率衡量。稅率變動對遞延稅資產及負債之影響，於包含立法生效日之會計期間，於營業收入中認列，如適用。
2022年3月，本公司與銀行簽訂五年期215.0百萬美元之企業信貸協議（"2022年貸款"）。該2022年貸款於2026年1月30日以發行及銷售500百萬美元高級債券之所得償還。2024年2月，本公司與銀行簽訂五年期75.0百萬美元之企業信貸協議（"2024年貸款"）。本公司於2025年、2024年及2023年分別產生24.6百萬美元、23.8百萬美元及16.6百萬美元之企業債務利息費用。

headings: 與我們財務表現、營運資金、流動性及資本實力以及總體經濟相關的風險
與我們業務相關的風險
與本公司普通股 ownership 相關的風險
不景氣的房地產市場、金融市場及總體經濟環境可能對我們的業務、營運成果及財務狀況產生負面影響。
不利的全球市場、經濟與政治環境，包括政府停擺、軍事衝突或恐怖攻擊、疫情及其他災難性事件，可能對我們產生重大負面影響。
對小型企業的貸款涉及高度的商業與財務風險，可能導致重大損失，進而對我們的業務、營運成果及財務狀況產生負面影響。
我們依賴部分關鍵人員以實現未來的成功，他們持續為本公司服務並非保證。
我們的成長策略依賴我們聘僱並留住合格的帳戶經理人，若我們無法做到，成長可能受到限制。
來自潛在借款人、擔保人及貸款池銷售相關賣方所收到的不正確或不完整資訊，可能對我們的營運結果產生負面影響。
房貸貸款發放流程中評估品質的缺失，可能導致本金損失程度增加。
我們在執行業務策略時使用槓桿，當經濟條件不利時，可能對我們產生負面影響。
房貸貸款發放流程中我們的授信指引，可能導致逾期與違約增加。
我們可能在未事先通知或股東同意的情況下改變策略或授信指引，這可能導致我們的風險特性、營運結果與財務狀況產生變化。
我們若無法有效管理未來的成長，可能對我們的業務、營運結果與財務狀況產生負面影響。
營運風險，包括網路攻擊及其他安全事件的風險，可能幹擾我們的業務，並對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。
若我們的科技基礎設施及系統可用性或功能受到幹擾，可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
收購、策略性投資、進入新業務領域及資產處置可能幹擾我們的業務，分散我們管理階層的注意力，導致股東持股進一步稀釋，並損害我們的業務。
與我們貸款組合相關的風險
我們貸款組閤中相當大一部分為投資者不動產貸款，這些貸款面臨較高的風險。
位於轉型中的不動產上的貸款，其損失風險將高於傳統的投資等級房貸，且借款人擁有完整的保險保障。
任何與完成拍賣或不動產清算相關的成本或延誤，可能會進一步減少該不動產的回報，並增加損失。
用以擔保房貸及不動產證券的保險，可能無法涵蓋所有損失。
本公司可能面臨貸款人責任索償，若本公司被認定需負此責任，可能會導致損失。
本公司可能因取得產權而面臨環境責任，此等責任可能導致相關不動產價值降低。
若本公司違反申述與保證，可能需買回或更換房貸貸款，或賠償投資人，此情形可能對本公司營運、現金流、營業成果及財務狀況造成損害。

投資本公司普通股涉及重大風險。我們在下文中說明管理階層認為會影響或可能影響我們營運表現之重大風險。瞭解這些風險對理解本年度報告中任何陳述及評估投資本公司普通股之決定至關重要。您應仔細閱讀並考量下文所描述之風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告中所包含或參考之所有其他資訊，再做任何投資本公司普通股之決定。若有任何下列風險實際發生，將可能對我們之業務、財務狀況、流動性及營運成果造成重大且不利之影響。若發生此情況，本公司普通股之價值可能顯著下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。
作為非銀行房貸公司，我們在正常營運過程中會面臨其他業者共同面對之多種風險。此外，我們所面臨之部分風險為Velocity所獨有，或對Velocity之影響可能與其他公司不同且更為顯著。這些風險可能對我們之業務、監管機構或機關之審批、財務狀況、流動性、營運成果、成長能力及聲譽造成不利影響，並於下文加以總結。此總結僅為補充，並非取代後續完整風險因素之說明。
• 房地產市場、金融市場及總體經濟之狀況
• 美國聯邦政府層面之財政政策或不作為，已導致並可能在未來導致聯邦政府停擺或對美國經濟造成負面影響
• 資本市場之動盪，包括因關稅、貿易限制、軍事衝突及其他地緣政治動盪或情況所導致之市場波動與經濟不穩定
